name: The Memory Carousel of Lost Toys
description: A vintage carousel where each horse is carved from different types of wood, and as it spins, forgotten toys appear in the reflections of a magical mirror lake.
prompt: An antique wooden carousel with hand-carved horses made from various exotic woods - mahogany, cherry, walnut. As it spins slowly, the reflection in a nearby mirror-smooth lake reveals forgotten childhood toys - tin robots, rag dolls, wooden trains - appearing and disappearing like memories. Golden carousel lights illuminate the scene in warm amber glow. Surrounding trees display vintage toy advertisements carved in bark. Nostalgic atmosphere, autumnal color palette, painterly realism.
caption: Round and round we go - where lost toys find their way back home... 🪀🐴
